title: Slip failure response — what an endpoint may send
description: Conformance for a publisher: the failure shape, with `code` narrowed to the eight codes version 1 lets an endpoint send. Codes raised only by a client are absent because nothing usable was received, so there is no body they could arrive in. A client validates against slip-error-response.schema.json instead — the two bind different parties, and the difference is normative.

code.description: Every code an endpoint may send in version 1. Client-raised codes are deliberately absent.
